home.title: Find fishing competitions, coastal markets and local events across Malaysia.
home.lead: Starting with Terengganu, Kelantan and Sabah. One place to discover what's on, and for organisers to reach the people who'll actually show up.

blurbs.competition: Shore, boat and kayak tournaments with prizes.
blurbs.market: Fresh catch straight from the jetty.
blurbs.pond: Ponds and sessions for a relaxed day out.

verified.title: Verified organisers
verified.body: Organisers can verify with their SSM registration, so you know who is behind each event.

payments.title: Pay the Malaysian way
payments.body: Listings paid by FPX online banking, cards or GrabPay, with instant receipts.

sharing.title: Built for sharing
sharing.body: Every event page previews nicely on WhatsApp, with directions and add-to-calendar.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.draft: Draft, to be reviewed before launch
privacy.collectBody: Your name, email address and password (stored only as a secure hash) when you create an account, plus the events you save and the organisers you follow. Organisers also give a contact number and, optionally, an SSM registration number.
privacy.whyBody: To run your account, show and remind you about events, verify organisers, and process payments. We do not sell your data.
privacy.whereBody: On Supabase servers in Singapore. Access is restricted so each user can only see their own personal data.
privacy.rightsBody: Under Malaysia's Personal Data Protection Act 2010 you can ask to see, correct or delete your data, and withdraw consent at any time by closing your account.
